To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the current ragweed pollen concentrations in a given year are most influenced by the current meteorological conditions and the past meteorological patterns.

the most important variables that influence the current Ambrosia season are the current mean temperature, the current dew point depression, the current wind speed, the current height of the planetary layer, the past mean temperature and the past height of the planetary level.

the most important meteorological factors for the daily ragweed pollen level during a current season are: mean and minimum temperatures and the dew point depression, and that the most important factors for the daily pollen level before the current season are: maximum, minimum and mean temperatures, and the height of planetary boundary layer.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of the most relevant meteorological factors for the pollen production of Ambrosia and the determination of the time periods in the past that have a significant influence on the current pollen season.
the sensitivity of daily ragweed airborne pollen concentrations on daily values of ten meteorological variables during the current pollen seasons and on the past meteorical conditions.
the development of a new approach for the analysis of the relationships between daily ragweed pollen levels and the meteorological variables.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ragweed pollen levels are not only influenced by meteorological variables in the current pollen season but also by meteorological variables before this season.
the ragweed pollen production is a complex phenomenon that is controlled by a variety of interacting meteorological variables.
the pollen levels of a certain day of the current pollen season depend on the meteorological elements of this day and also on the past values of meteorological elements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a new approach was used to explore the associations of the current ragweed pollen levels with current as well as with past meteorological elements, and that the results obtained may contribute to a more precise prediction of ragweed pollen concentrations in the upcoming season.
the pollen season is influenced by the current and past meteorology.
the ragweed pollen concentrations of a pollen season can be predicted from the past meteorological data, which can be used to forecast the upcoming pollen season.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current pollen season is sensitive to the current and the past meteorological elements, which is an indication that the ragweed pollen season may be predicted by the past meteorological data.
the pollen season of a given year is not only determined by meteorological elements during this season but it is also influenced by meteorological elements before the pollen season.
the current pollen season is not only affected by current meteorological variables but also by the previous ones.
